newsitem.title: USA: American Filtrona says merger pact ended.
newsitem.headline: American Filtrona says merger pact ended.

text.p: American Filtrona Corp., a maker of bonded fiber and plastic products, said Friday that British-based WBT Holdings LLC called off a proposed merger of the two companies.
The Richmond, Va.-based company said its board of directors authorised a special committee of the board to explore other alternatives, including a sale of the company.

American Filtrona announced in February that it had agreed to be acquired by WBT Holdings, which is owned by several trusts for the benefit of the late Walter Bunzl, for $46.52 in cash per share, or $174 million, based on American Filtrona's 3.75 million shares outstanding.
Under the pact, WBT would then have sold American Filtrona's bonded fibers business to British-based Bunzl Plc for $72.45 million in cash.
American Filtrona's stock fell $4 to $41 early on Nasdaq.
